summary: Trinseo PLC filed an 8-K disclosing a restructuring support agreement with a majority of senior lenders to implement a comprehensive Chapter 11 restructuring. The plan will discharge approximately $2.0 billion of prepetition funded debt, reducing annual interest by ~$140 million. Existing lenders will receive 100% of reorganized equity; current equity holders will be cancelled with no recovery. The restructuring will be effectuated through a joint Chapter 11 plan filed in the Southern District of Texas. Operations are expected to continue in the ordinary course as debtors-in-possession. Key watchpoint: court approval and creditor voting.
